title: Bluetooth Scan Issue when using 2 versions of XDRIP
symptom: When trying to scan for the Bluetooth device on either phone, you have to turn off the other phone before the MiaoMiao will display. This causes an issue when adding a smartwatch as a collector, as xDrip fails to reconnect to the phone when back in range because it cannot see the Bluetooth device.
cause: MiaoMiao cannot connect to two devices at the same time.
fix: Use one xDrip (or both) to upload data to a MongoDB instance, and have the main xDrip read data from both Bluetooth and MongoDB. Instructions: create an account on mlab.com, enable Nightscout and upload Libre transmitter data on the watch, then on the main phone select 'libre wifi' or 'libre bluetooth + wifi' as the hardware data source and enter the MongoDB address in the list of receivers.
settings_changed: cloud upload -> mongo db -> enable nightscout
cloud upload -> mongo db -> enter the mongodb uri
cloud upload -> mongo db -> enable 'upload libre transmitter data'
hw data source -> 'libre wifi' or 'libre bluetooth + wifi'
evidence_quote: miaomiao can not connect to two devices, not much that we can do about it. But what we can do, is to have one xdrip (or both) also upload the data to a mongo device. Once this is done, you can have the main xdrip read the data from BT and the mongo, and as such, it will always be able to have the correct values.
